description: Source file implementing media type handling and decoder creation functions for Windows platform, including AV1 decoder support and media type filtering.

methods.name: ConvertWin32TimeToUsec
methods.description: Converts Win32 time units (100ns) to microseconds.

methods.name: GetAllOutputMediaTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available output media types for a given decoder and stream ID.

methods.name: GetAllInputMediaTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available input media types for a given transform and stream ID.

methods.name: FilterMediaBySubType
methods.description: Filters a list of media types by a specific subtype GUID.

methods.name: CreateAV1Decoder
methods.description: Creates an AV1 decoder instance using Media Foundation.

methods.name: CreateDecoderTransform
methods.description: Creates a decoder transform instance based on a GUID, with special handling for AV1.

methods.name: IsHardwareAv1DecoderSupported
methods.description: Checks if hardware-accelerated AV1 decoding is supported on the system.
